Artillery and missile crew members operate artillery and missile launch systems in military combat units. They load ammunition, enter firing data, aim and launch weapons, and provide coordinated support, turning fire orders into impacts at the operational level of the strike chain.

paragraphs: After morning physical training, report to the firing position and repeatedly practice coordinated loading and launch procedures. On live-fire days, the full crew takes position and acts in sequence on the crew leader's command as radar locks the target, fire control calculates the solution, and the weapon fires. Afterward, review deviations and record each issue in the training log.
